name: Call of Water
summary: At Silverpine's coast, you finish the Call of Water at the Brazier of Everfount. The rite clears nearby corruption, and a spirit of pure water appears.

sections.title: A Burst of Cleansing Light
sections.body: At the Brazier of Everfount, your final words summon a burst of light. It scatters the minor spirits threatening the spring, and the shore falls quiet.

sections.title: The Water's Gratitude
sections.body: Once the spirits are gone, a Minor Manifestation of Water appears beside the brazier. The spirit thanks you for the rite and says the taint here has ebbed. Yet life across Silverpine's decaying lands continues to wane, so the Horde's shamans must stay watchful to preserve it.

faq.q: What happens when the brazier ritual finishes?
faq.answer: Your final incantation at the Brazier of Everfount releases a burst of light. It destroys the nearby corrupted spirits and purifies the surrounding flow of water.

faq.q: Who is the Minor Manifestation of Water?
faq.answer: The Minor Manifestation of Water is a small elemental of pure water. It appears after the corrupted elementals near the Brazier of Everfount are destroyed.

faq.q: What does the water spirit say about Silverpine?
faq.answer: The spirit thanks the shamans and says the local corruption has ebbed. Yet life across Silverpine continues to wane and needs constant care.

faq.q: Where does this ritual take place?
faq.answer: The ritual takes place at the Brazier of Everfount along the coast of Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Why must shamans intervene in Silverpine?
faq.answer: Shamans must defend distant, embattled waters from blight and lingering corruption. These trials test their commitment to balance and earn them the Water Totem.

faq.q: What comes next in the trials?
faq.answer: After meeting the Minor Manifestation of Water, the shaman receives elemental remains or guidance to finish the journey and forge the Water Totem.

angles.text: As a shaman, you prove your resolve by healing suffering waters far from home. You earn communion with the spirit of water.
As a member of the Horde, you help cleanse corrupted waterways in Forsaken-controlled Silverpine and preserve elemental harmony.
